en: The status of being a candidate in an election.
en_example: He announced his candidacy for president last year.
zh_example: 他去年宣布參加總統選舉。
ja: 選挙で候補者としての地位や状態。
local: The status of being a candidate in an election.
ja_example: 彼は昨年、大統領選に立候補すると発表しました。
local_example: He announced his candidacy for president last year.

en: The field or environment where political activities and debates occur.
en_example: She entered the political arena to fight for social justice.
zh_example: 她進入政治舞台為社會正義而奮鬥。
ja: 政治的な活動や議論が行われる場や環境。
local: The field or environment where political activities and debates occur.
ja_example: 彼女は社会正義のために政治の場に入りました。
local_example: She entered the political arena to fight for social justice.

en: A person who has been formally chosen as a candidate for an office or honor.
en_example: She was the party's nominee for governor.
zh_example: 她是該黨的州長候選人。
ja: 公職や栄誉の候補者として正式に選ばれた人。
local: A person who has been formally chosen as a candidate for an office or honor.
ja_example: 彼女は党の知事候補に選ばれました。
local_example: She was the party's nominee for governor.

zh: 千禧世代（約1980-2000年出生的人）
en: People born approximately between 1980 and 2000.
en_example: Many millennials prefer digital communication over phone calls.
zh_example: 許多千禧世代偏好數位溝通勝過電話。
ja: おおよそ1980年から2000年の間に生まれた世代の人々。
local: People born approximately between 1980 and 2000.
ja_example: 多くのミレニアル世代は電話よりもデジタルでのコミュニケーションを好みます。
local_example: Many millennials prefer digital communication over phone calls.

en: The official connection or membership with a political party.
en_example: His party affiliation is independent, not Republican or Democrat.
zh_example: 他的政黨隸屬是獨立，不是共和黨或民主黨。
ja: 政治党派との公式な関係や所属。
local: The official connection or membership with a political party.
ja_example: 彼の党派所属は共和党でも民主党でもなく、無所属です。
local_example: His party affiliation is independent, not Republican or Democrat.

en: A person who fights or struggles to achieve something.
en_example: My father is a fighter who never gives up.
zh_example: 我父親是一個永不放棄的鬥士。
ja: 何かを達成するために戦ったり努力したりする人。
local: A person who fights or struggles to achieve something.
ja_example: 私の父は決してあきらめない闘志のある人です。
local_example: My father is a fighter who never gives up.

en: To struggle or work hard to achieve or protect something.
en_example: He fights for his family and employees.
zh_example: 他為家人和員工奮鬥。
ja: 何かを守ったり達成したりするために努力したり闘ったりすること。
local: To struggle or work hard to achieve or protect something.
ja_example: 彼は家族と従業員のために闘っています。
local_example: He fights for his family and employees.

zh: 有彈性的，能迅速恢復的
en: Able to recover quickly from difficulties or setbacks.
en_example: He showed us how to be resilient in the face of challenges.
zh_example: 他教我們如何在挑戰面前保持彈性。
ja: 困難や挫折から素早く立ち直ることができる性質。
local: Able to recover quickly from difficulties or setbacks.
ja_example: 彼は困難に直面しても強く立ち直る方法を教えてくれました。
local_example: He showed us how to be resilient in the face of challenges.

en: The capacity to develop or succeed in the future.
en_example: One of my father's talents is seeing potential in people.
zh_example: 我父親的才能之一是能看到人的潛力。
ja: 将来に成長したり成功したりする能力や可能性。
local: The capacity to develop or succeed in the future.
ja_example: 父の才能の一つは、人の可能性を見抜くことです。
local_example: One of my father's talents is seeing potential in people.

en: Lack of fairness or justice.
en_example: He helped people facing injustice or hardship.
zh_example: 他幫助面臨不公正或困難的人。
ja: 公平さや正義が欠けている状態。
local: Lack of fairness or justice.
ja_example: 彼は不正や困難に直面している人々を助けました。
local_example: He helped people facing injustice or hardship.

en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of others.
en_example: I have witnessed his empathy towards those who are suffering.
zh_example: 我見證了他對受苦者的同理心。
ja: 他人の感情を理解し共感する能力。
local: The ability to understand and share the feelings of others.
ja_example: 私は彼が苦しんでいる人々に対して示す共感を目の当たりにしました。
local_example: I have witnessed his empathy towards those who are suffering.

en: Sympathetic concern for the sufferings of others.
en_example: He has the kindness and compassion to be a great leader.
zh_example: 他有成為偉大領袖的善良與同情心。
ja: 他人の苦しみに対する思いやりや同情の気持ち。
local: Sympathetic concern for the sufferings of others.
ja_example: 彼には偉大なリーダーになるための優しさと思いやりがあります。
local_example: He has the kindness and compassion to be a great leader.

zh: 精英管理制度，能力主義
en: A system in which people are chosen and promoted based on their abilities and merits.
en_example: Construction sites are true meritocracies where skill is rewarded.
zh_example: 建築工地是真正的能力主義，技能受到獎勵。
ja: 能力や実績に基づいて人が選ばれ昇進する制度。
local: A system in which people are chosen and promoted based on their abilities and merits.
ja_example: 建設現場は技術が評価される真の実力主義の場です。
local_example: Construction sites are true meritocracies where skill is rewarded.

zh: 不分膚色的，不以膚色區別的
en: Not discriminating based on race or color.
en_example: He is colorblind and hires the best person for the job.
zh_example: 他不分膚色，聘用最適合的人。
ja: 人種や肌の色によって差別しないこと。
local: Not discriminating based on race or color.
ja_example: 彼は人種にとらわれず、仕事に最適な人を雇います。
local_example: He is colorblind and hires the best person for the job.

en: The main earners who provide income for a household.
en_example: 40% of American households have female primary breadwinners.
zh_example: 40%的美國家庭由女性主要負擔經濟來源。
ja: 世帯の収入を主に支える稼ぎ手。
local: The main earners who provide income for a household.
ja_example: アメリカの世帯の40％は女性が主な稼ぎ手です。
local_example: 40% of American households have female primary breadwinners.

en: The care and supervision of young children, especially during working hours.
en_example: He will focus on making quality childcare affordable and accessible.
zh_example: 他將致力於讓優質托兒服務變得負擔得起且普及。
ja: 特に働いている間の幼い子供の世話や監督。
local: The care and supervision of young children, especially during working hours.
ja_example: 彼は質の高い保育を手頃で利用しやすくすることに注力します。
local_example: He will focus on making quality childcare affordable and accessible.

en: To bring back to a former or original state.
en_example: A Trump presidency will restore the great American tradition.
zh_example: 川普總統任期將恢復偉大的美國傳統。
ja: 以前の状態や元の状態に戻すこと。
local: To bring back to a former or original state.
ja_example: トランプ大統領は偉大なアメリカの伝統を取り戻すでしょう。
local_example: A Trump presidency will restore the great American tradition.

en: Continuing without becoming weaker or less severe.
en_example: He will be relentless in his determination to achieve goals.
zh_example: 他將不懈地決心達成目標。
ja: 弱くなったり、緩んだりせずに続けること。
local: Continuing without becoming weaker or less severe.
ja_example: 彼は目標を達成するために絶え間なく努力し続けるでしょう。
local_example: He will be relentless in his determination to achieve goals.

en: Severe suffering or privation.
en_example: Other politicians see these hardships but only my father will fight for you.
zh_example: 其他政治人物看到這些困難，但只有我父親會為你奮鬥。
ja: 厳しい苦しみや困難な状況。
local: Severe suffering or privation.
ja_example: 他の政治家はこれらの困難を理解しても、戦うのは私の父だけです。
local_example: Other politicians see these hardships but only my father will fight for you.

en: The ability to do something successfully or efficiently.
en_example: Judge his competency by the towers he has built.
zh_example: 以他建造的高樓來評斷他的能力。
ja: 物事を成功裏に、または効率的に行う能力。
local: The ability to do something successfully or efficiently.
ja_example: 彼が建てた塔で彼の能力を判断してください。
local_example: Judge his competency by the towers he has built.

en: A person who fights or argues for a cause or on behalf of someone.
en_example: He will be your greatest, truest, and most loyal champion.
zh_example: 他將是你最偉大、最真誠、最忠誠的擁護者。
ja: ある目的や誰かのために戦ったり主張したりする人。
local: A person who fights or argues for a cause or on behalf of someone.
ja_example: 彼はあなたの最も偉大で誠実、そして忠実な擁護者になるでしょう。
local_example: He will be your greatest, truest, and most loyal champion.
